l1.exp: 1=D (railway station nearby → take the train), 2=E (Internet café → email me), 3=C (thanks for notes), 4=F (don’t get up → stay in bed), 5=B (cold in mountains → bring warm clothes). A (Come to the hotel) je suvišno.

l9.exp: Muzej je otvoren do 22h četvrtkom, a danas je četvrtak → idu u muzej.

l14.exp: Hotel je conference centre next to the airport (“next to the airport”).
